sourceFull: Data: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, reply to Parliament (2024 figures)
signoff: Built in Bengaluru  ·  Open to collaboration

segs.text: In twenty twenty-four, potholes killed two thousand three hundred and eighty-five people on India's roads.
parts: In twenty twenty-four, potholes killed two thousand three hundred and eighty-five people on India's roads.

segs.text: That's more than six people, every single day.
parts: That's more than six people, every single day.

segs.text: Every Bengalurean knows the moment. The sudden jolt. The swerve. The held breath.
parts: The sudden jolt. The swerve. The held breath.

segs.text: A pothole isn't one failure. It's rain, heavy loads, rushed repairs, and roads dug up again and again by crews who never talk.
parts: It's rain, heavy loads, rushed repairs, and roads dug up again and again by crews who never talk.

segs.text: And it isn't just Bengaluru. Every city on Earth fights the same battle between water, weight and time.
parts: Every city on Earth fights the same battle between water, weight and time.

segs.text: What if roads could report their own damage, before it became a hole?
parts: What if roads could report their own damage, before it became a hole?

segs.text: Cracks spotted early. Repairs planned by need, not by noise. Every job, its cost and its quality, open for anyone to check.
parts: Repairs planned by need, not by noise.
Every job, its cost and its quality, open for anyone to check.

segs.text: Intelligence like A.L.K.I. could help plan it. OmniChain is designed to keep that record honest. And OmniBot is being built to take on the heavy, dangerous work.
parts: Intelligence like A.L.K.I. could help plan it.
OmniChain is designed to keep that record honest.
And OmniBot is being built to take on the heavy, dangerous work.

segs.text: No department builds this alone. It takes engineers, contractors, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.
parts: It takes engineers, contractors, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.

segs.text: One hand can't lift a road. A thousand hands can.
parts: One hand can't lift a road. A thousand hands can.

segs.text: Six lives a day. Let's build roads that bring everyone home.
parts: Six lives a day. Let's build roads that bring everyone home.
